items.author: iotex_io

items.new_information: Ubuntu仍无修复内核、Debian已有修复，并给出丢弃IP选项包或关闭MPTCP的临时缓解及其局限
items.urgency_reason: Ubuntu暂无修复内核，运行Go 1.24+节点的服务器需当日升级或先行缓解

evidence.quote: CVE-2026-98432 is a critical Linux kernel bug (CVSS 9.8) that can let an attacker get remote root over TCP. If you are running an IoTeX delegate on an affected Linux kernel, please patch today. 🧵

Go 1.24+ turns on Multipath TCP (MPTCP) for listeners by default, so iotex-core's P2P port 4689 listens over MPTCP. That is exactly the path the demonstrated remote-root exploit uses. You don't need to have enabled anything yourself.
Fix: upgrade the kernel, then reboot
• Debian 12/13: apt update && apt install linux-image-amd64 → 6.1.190+ / 6.12.113+
• Ubuntu (all releases): no fixed kernel yet. Apply the mitigation below 👇
Drop IPv4 packets that carry IP options, which the exploit needs:
目前 ubuntu 还没发行修复版本，你可以先在你的服务器关闭开放的端口，或者关闭 MPTCP：
sudo sysctl -w net.mptcp.enabled=0
用 Go 1.24+ 的要注意，Go 默认开 MPTCP，目前演示的攻击就是走这条路
临时可以先执行：sysctl -w net.mptcp.enabled=0
但这只能降低风险，普通 TCP 照样可能被打
真正的修复是升级内核 + 重启

items.summary: Percolator公开清算逻辑：任何人都可无许可触发清算，引擎用二分搜索找出使账户回到维持保证金之上的最小平仓量。它没有ADL队列，对手方持仓按比例缩减；超额亏损先由该市场保险预算覆盖，剩余部分按仓位比例分摊。
items.author: PercolatorTrade
items.new_information: 无ADL队列，部分清算并按比例分摊亏损

evidence.quote: Anyone can do it. Liquidation runs inside a permissionless crank: no keeper whitelist, and the caller doesn't need an account or collateral on Percolator.

The caller doesn't choose the size either. The engine settles losses against collateral, then binary searches for the smallest close it projects will put the account back above maintenance, after the liquidation fee. If no partial close gets there, or the account is already underwater, that position closes in full.
There's no ADL queue.
The closed size isn't dumped into a book. Open interest on the other side shrinks to match, and every position on that side is cut by the same ratio.
If losses run past the account's collateral, that market's insurance budget covers what it can.
Anything left is shared pro rata across the other side of the same market, by position size.
There's no ADL queue.

evidence.quote: Devs just built Sage2, a streaming decision model that computes each token of a conversation once.
The setup is closer to a database cursor than an API call. A session holds the context on the server, and new messages are appended to it, not re-sent.
The cached computation over the earlier context is reused. Each new message adds only its own tokens to the cost, and every registered question is re-evaluated against the full history.
On progressive context, this makes decisions 3x faster, with responses in tens of ms.
- Decide: the first decision model with streaming. 3x faster, because it reads the context as it grows.
With Sage 2, you describe the fields you need, and it returns structured values with the exact source text and a probability for each result.

evidence.quote: 二、画布有三种，命运不一样
第一种，画推理。
每个节点是一段 prompt，连线是“先想这个，再想那个”。扣子、元器都在这一类。这类正在消退。
第二种，画连接。
节点是 API 和系统，连线是数据从哪来、到哪去。“收到邮件附件，存进网盘”，这种事不需要模型想，更需要便宜稳定的执行结果。Zapier、n8n、Dify 在这一类。这类还活着。不过 n8n 估值 52 亿美元，披露的年收入大约 4000 万。但估值里有不少是故事。
第三种，不画，直接写代码。
但底下有一层运行时，管状态、管重试、管崩溃以后从哪一步接着跑。Temporal、Restate、Inngest。这一层最硬。Temporal 今年估值到了 125.5 亿美元，年化收入超过 2.5 亿，增长超过 200%。OpenAI、Netflix 都在用。
而我后来一直用一个问题检查自己做的东西：下一代模型强十倍，我的生意变好，还是变没？
画推理的画布：变没。因为模型自己会想。
运行时：变好。Agent 跑得越久、调的工具越多，出错的地方就越多，越需要有东西兜住它。
第二个，是以什么为准。对账平不平，要看银行流水。图合不合规，要看平台审核。真相在系统外面，模型不能自己当裁判。
